scope: Task D x Task A — P2 intra-query multi-walker (workers in {1, 2, 4}, inter-query jobs == 1)

baseline_p1_invariance.workers_1_delegation: workers == 1 executes exact entry_best_first_v1 traversal order using persistent settled_epoch table (bit-identical hits, squared_l2, and P1 counters to task_da::Index::search)

fields.distance_evaluations: Total exact squared-L2 computations summed across all workers (>= 1).
fields.unique_distance_evaluations: Count of distinct vertices evaluated at least once during the query (<= distance_evaluations).
fields.expansions: Total vertex pop-and-expand operations summed across all workers (alias total_expansions).
fields.unique_expansions: Count of distinct vertices expanded at least once during the query (>= 1).
fields.duplicate_expansions: expansions - unique_expansions (true duplicate vertex expansions across workers; strictly separated from already_seen_attempts; == 0 when workers == 1).
fields.neighbor_attempts: Total directed outgoing arcs inspected across all expanded vertices.
fields.already_seen_attempts: Arc inspections hitting settled_epoch or worker local_seen before computing distance (revisit edge checks, NOT duplicate vertex expansions).
fields.frontier_insertions: Total candidate insertions into bounded candidate frontiers.
fields.sync_merge_count: Number of round merge/rebalance barriers after initial entry fanout (0 when workers == 1).
fields.sync_wait_ns: Worker-nanoseconds active workers spent waiting at merge barriers + serial merge duration (summed over active workers in Mode ON; 0 when workers == 1).
fields.barrier_wait_ns: Worker-nanoseconds active workers spent waiting strictly for peer stragglers at arrival barriers before merge begins (0 when workers == 1).
fields.merge_time_ns: Nanoseconds spent inside the single-writer global_best merge and round-robin frontier rebalance step (0 when workers == 1).
fields.worker_idle_ns: Worker-nanoseconds workers spent completely unscheduled in rounds where assigned frontier slice was empty (0 when workers == 1).
fields.per_worker_expansions: Array of length == workers listing expansions executed by each worker (entry counted on worker 0).
fields.per_worker_distance_evaluations: Array of length == workers listing L2 distance evaluations computed by each worker (entry & entry-neighbors counted on worker 0).
fields.per_worker_idle_rounds: Array of length == workers listing number of rounds where that worker received 0 frontier seeds.

required_invariants_mode_on: workers == 1 implies duplicate_expansions == 0, duplicate_distance_evaluations == 0, sync_merge_count == 0, sync_wait_ns == 0, worker_idle_ns == 0
